visible_yellow_baseline.boundary_definition: All visible-yellow component boundaries, including hardware occlusion edges; no hidden completion.

normalization.formula: x=(u-x0)/L; y=(y_bottom-v)/L; x right, y up
normalization.limitation: L is the observed visible-yellow projected x-span, including small exposed yellow regions. Hidden full-shell fore-aft length is not observed. This normalization definition must be confirmed; not physical length.

requested_gates.pixel_change_definition: Full shell geometry projection with all accessories hidden; XOR/union on same pixel grid. Do not count material/light changes or accessory refitting toward the5% shell-shape gate.
requested_gates.mask_and_L_scope_status: Provisional visible-mask reference and visible x-span; user confirmation required before treating as final acceptance definition.

comparison_stage: baseline only, not an iteration passed

window_tilt.limitation: Curved short visible seat edge versus model in-plane vertical direction are not a uniquely identified real plane. ±5° observation uncertainty exceeds requested3° gate; user must confirm target definition before claiming a pass.

limits: Visible-mask IoU includes differences from accessories and occlusion, not only shell shape.
No hidden shell silhouette is invented from metal/strap edges.
No true front photograph supplied, so front view is diagnostic only.
Existing estimated camera retained; not a uniquely recovered camera.
Step4 reconstruction and Step5 refitting await explicit point/angle confirmation.

current_occlusion_diagnostic.conditions: Only if current camera, current opaque accessory coverage and shell-behind-accessories order are all fixed. Not a bound after authorized contact-part refitting or different cameras. Not a reason to lower the user acceptance gate.
